user.description: Select your country and type your city or postal code to search for nearby Lidl stores. Optionally, check the box below to log in to Lidl Plus for coupons and receipts.

data.country: Country Code (e.g., DE, AT, BE, ES, FR, NL, PL)

login.description:
Enter your Lidl Plus email/phone number and password. The integration will attempt automatic login.

If automatic login fails (e.g. due to Captcha protection), you will be directed to Web Login / Token entry.

mfa.description: A verification code has been sent to your registered phone or email. Please enter it below.

manual_token.description:
Automatic login was blocked by bot protection (Captcha / Akamai).

**Browser Login Instructions (Chrome/Firefox/Edge):**
1. [Click here to open the Lidl Plus login page]({login_url})
2. Open Developer Tools (**F12 → Network tab**, and enable 'Preserve log').
3. Log in with your email and password (and complete MFA if prompted).
4. After login, your browser may show an error ("Can't reach this page" or "Oops!") — this is normal because desktop browsers cannot handle the `com.lidlplus.app://` mobile protocol.
5. In the Network tab, look for the entry starting with `com.lidlplus.app` or `callback?code=`. Copy the full URL (e.g. `com.lidlplus.app://callback?code=...&state=...`).
6. Paste this full callback URL (or directly paste your 20+ character refresh token) below.
